SINGLE_HYPOTHESIS: In ProcessWideFp32CachedRows, move the RMS finalize's 1-element vector ops (Duplicate + Sqrt) from the x staging buffer onto the reduce buffer, and move the staging release (SyncVToMTE2) to right after the squareSum pull. Then x/res staging is free while the finalize runs, and the first pass-2 gamma/bias load issues into the freed staging and overlaps the finalize's V/S round trips. The finalize arithmetic is unchanged (Duplicate + Sqrt + scalar reciprocal on the same value, just held in reduceLocal[0] instead of xLocal[0]); no Rsqrt/Reciprocal; store, dispatch, tile constants, and the pass-2 H5 logic are untouched.
WHY_NOT_DUPLICATE: V023 restructured the finalize's ARITHMETIC (vector-pipe meanSquare Muls+Adds + Rsqrt, corrected to Sqrt). V027 keeps the finalize arithmetic unchanged and only changes WHERE the 1-element ops live and WHEN the staging is released — a buffer-role and sync-placement change, not an arithmetic change. V025/H4 was pass-1 residual staging liveness; V026/H5 was pass-2 parameter staging liveness; V027 is the pass-1/pass-2 BOUNDARY staging release. V021 moved the pass-2 SyncMTE3ToV (store-drain wait); V027 does not touch the store drain. R31B H1 (store drain deferral) and STORE-EPILOGUE-X H1 (blocked writeback) untouched. R31B H3 (pass-1/pass-2 sync reduction) is the flagged adjacency: V027's specific mechanism is 'move the 1-element finalize ops onto the reduce buffer so the x/res staging is freed before the finalize, letting the first pass-2 parameter load overlap the finalize'. If R31B H3 reduces a different sync edge, the two are distinct; this must be confirmed at declaration against R31B H3's exact spec. Full analysis in 研究/R31A/next-hypotheses-v2.md H6 section.

MECHANISM_DETAIL.finalize_buffer: Duplicate + Sqrt move from xLocal[0] (xBuf_) to reduceLocal[0] (reduceFp32Buf_). reduceLocal is the SRC of the cross-tile ReduceSum and is free after it; the 1-element ops fit in the 8-float reduce buffer.
MECHANISM_DETAIL.staging_release: SyncVToMTE2 moves from after invRms to right after the squareSum GetValue, when xBuf_/resBuf_ are already free (cross-tile ReduceSum done).
MECHANISM_DETAIL.first_tile_prefetch: the first pass-2 gamma/bias load issues into the freed staging right after the SyncVToMTE2 and overlaps the finalize's V/S round trips (2 SyncVToS + 2 SyncSToV + scalar math + Duplicate + Sqrt). The pass-2 tile loop's paramsPrefetched flag starts true so the first tile skips its own load; the H5 next-tile prefetch logic is unchanged.

PRECISION_RISK: None. The finalize computes the same Duplicate + Sqrt + 1.0f/ on the same meanSquare value; only the buffer holding the 1-element intermediates changes (reduceLocal[0] instead of xLocal[0]).
